dry_run.description: Report what WOULD be deleted without touching disk.

data_root_report.description: Opt in to the advisory data-root scan: when true, the receipt carries data_root_unrecognized. Capability negotiation for engine-version skew — a client omits this unless the serving daemon is the SAME engine version, so an older daemon never sees the unknown request key and an older client never receives the unknown receipt key.

ControlGcRequest.description: Run one retention pass over engine-owned runtime artifacts.
